beats.say: 9 games: Kylian Mbappé ended Barcelona's winning streak in the 87th minute.
The Spotify Camp Nou fell silent as Real Madrid secured a 2.1 victory against their rivals.
Raphinha scored the only goal for Barcelona, but the French striker scored twice to seal the win.
According to Sky Sports, this was Real Madrid's first win in Barcelona for three years.
The Guardian says Mbappé has now scored 10 goals against Barcelona during his career.
Hansi Flick noted his team lacked freshness as their perfect nine game league run finally stopped.
